title: Correct Madagascar legal citations and omitted Namorona transfer in source handoff
body:
Raised and independently verified 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1352 merge `af355b897c9e3607de610549cfffb890c8e43378`; the same source claims persist in the two inspected source-handoff files of later PR #1368 merge `839883ae281af7bf012f694698624a7ec77275e1`. This does not represent a completed audit of #1368.

The retained Madagascar source handoff has three related source-interpretation errors:

1. `source-restoration.json` attributes the publication/effect clause to Article7 in both Law2021-012 and Law2023-012. Neither inspected law has Article7. In [Law2021-012](https://cnlegis.gov.mg/uploads/L2021-012-VF.pdf), the immediate-effect clause is Article4 (PDF pages2–3), followed by journal publication in Article5. In [Law2023-012](https://cnlegis.gov.mg/uploads/L2023-012_VF.pdf), those are Articles5 and6 (PDF page3). Promulgation dates are supported; the exact contingent broadcast/posting/publication dates remain unknown and must remain unknown. This finding corrects citations, not a legal effective-date determination.
2. The 2021 regional handoff records three districts per successor region and says other commune attachments remain unchanged, but omits the law's explicit exception: Article1 (PDF page1) moves **Namorona commune from Mananjary district to Manakara district**; the annex (PDF page4) also lists Namorona under Manakara. The complete pinned2018 COD-PS ADM3 CSV has one Namorona row: Commune `MG23209490`, parent Mananjary `MG23209`, old region `MG23`. Original output joins current Mananjary `gb:MDG:ADM2:10022922B52512193010711` to COD-AB `MG26209`/Vatovavy and current Manakara Atsimo `gb:MDG:ADM2:10022922B29911348985828` to COD-AB `MG27210`/Fitovinany. Both current districts still share parent `framework:province:vatovavy-fitovinany:fd10ec52071e`. An engineering handoff that treats this only as whole-district regrouping misses an expressly cited commune transfer relevant to the two district source/boundary comparisons. The name joins and small measured differences do not establish whether either polygon already reflects the transfer. Do not invent a new commune code, approved boundary, precise effective date or import authorization.
3. README says the government portal gives older Vatovavy-Fitovinany context, whereas its own `source-restoration.json` and the independently read [government table](https://torolalana.gov.mg/fr/services/regions-et-districts/) explicitly separate Vatovavy and Fitovinany. The portal still lists23regions/119districts, omits Antanimora and groups Mananara Nord/Maroantsetra under Analanjirofo; it is legitimately limited/potentially stale for the later changes. Describe those actual contradictions without implying it retains the unsplit2021region.

Reproduction/evidence: restore the complete canonical PDFs privately under the existing32MiB/256MiB limits; verify Law2021 52,879bytes SHA256 `bdb238f48484e8ddaa189c6d29c4be76ed27c2ff8aeb3eead192eda68b592210`, Law2023 129,279bytes SHA256 `15821ddd4a6012f2c3819baae2d00ae481ddac0cb17e139e10bc48390a9936a0`. The auditor restored both exact complete bodies, extracted every page and visually inspected the relevant law/annex pages. Compare source paragraphs to original1352 README SHA `ab53b394ec1b3031210eb47d6cdcc1be7893dce12083e1903581c9536e011141` and source-restoration SHA `6f71c038b1e4a22f07ee9d957a6dad35783861a9ca90d9ef03b15f6985a94e9f`; both mistakes also remain in later1368 copies. Trace the actual whole2018 CSV SHA `e099269fe3de11229b35bf332014b5c02c0bc77110768e9424265457dcace4e3` and original run14 crosswalk SHA `7b2345ba194ecdf8c2831ce1361f28475a114bef99e8a644112b55f269051a34` rather than inferring continuity from equal names.

Success criteria:

- One additive source-only erratum in the disjoint owned prefix below, covering the three claims and their actual sources. Preserve all original1352 and later1368 files/modes, historical runs/failed receipts, every119locationID and22parent group, CSV measurements and source/legal/rights unknowns. Do not edit shared hierarchy, coordinates or either original packet.
- Correct the two exact article citations; include printed/PDF page distinctions where applicable and preserve unknown legal publication/effective dates. Record canonical URLs, actual full bytes/hashes, native source roles and licensing limits; a URL or matching digest alone is not supporting content. No unlicensed source redistribution.
- Give a bounded Namorona old-code/old-parent/legal-new-parent trace and the two exact affected current district IDs. Explicitly state unknown post-transfer commune code/territory continuity and whether the retained source/current district polygons incorporate the transfer. Limit the future engineering handoff accordingly; do not infer geographic corrections or expand original632ownership.
- Reconcile README versus source ledger against the actual portal rows. Preserve its legitimate contradictions/undated-page limit, the separate2018commune versus newer district distinction, eight-commune decree versus four-commune operational-purpose limit, MapAction secondary role and all unresolved predecessor/source boundary work.
- Pin original and later files at their actual immutable commits using the existing historical-file format when both vintages are consumed. Bind all consequential erratum claims and any generated reports to independent raw references; test missing/wrong article references and missing Namorona row/parent so a coherent refreshed candidate cannot falsely claim verification. If a writer is added, admit complete inputs/decoded bodies and fresh destinations before writes, test ordinary/dangling-link collisions, preserve partial failures and verify actual comparison products. Do not manufacture unrelated GIS experiments for this source-only correction.
- Obtain a distinct substantive exact-head source review. Any corrective PR is separately audited; closure preserves the original audit finding.

Deduplication: complete all-state API discovery (15pages of100 plus6 entries) and a fresh recent-page delta, every then-open PR's complete file inventory and affected source-packet history found no existing bounded repair for these citations/Namorona omission. Original #632 remains open with its two allowed partial PRs already used and canonical claim released; #481 is the broader regional umbrella. Their uncompleted source/geometry/legal work remains separately owned. Closed prerequisite #482 supplied the pinned source packet. It is the only execution dependency; the additive citation erratum does not require closing unresolved632. No worker reservation is acquired and no old PR budget is enlarged. Initially blocked until the shared read-only scope/dependency/ownership/readiness review passes.

Limits: read-only source interpretation and exact-vintage numerical evidence. No legal/geographic approval, full present-day authoritative boundary inventory, original BNGRC restoration, production acceptance, import or deployment. Review of the secondary MapAction map does not replace primary BNGRC evidence. The119subject scope bounds the source handoff; the two Namorona districts are the specific transfer subjects.
